document.label: Accessible name of the area that shows one page of a Space (product noun Space): its header, text and chat.
document.all-pages: Button in the page's header that goes back to the Space's library of pages.
document.toggle-outline: Icon button that shows or hides the list of the Space's pages beside the page.
document.editor-loading: Shown where the text editor will be while it loads.
document.download-name: File name (without .md) of a downloaded page that has no title. Lowercase, no spaces.
document.status.saving: Save status in the page's header: the page is being saved.
document.status.saved: Save status in the page's header: every change is saved.
document.status.dirty: Save status in the page's header: changes wait to be saved (in a moment, automatically).
document.status.conflict: Save status in the page's header: someone else changed the page, and the person must choose what to keep.
document.status.error: Save status in the page's header: the last save failed.
document.menu.label: Accessible name of the page's ⋯ menu button and of the menu.
document.menu.save: Menu item that saves the page now. "⌘/Ctrl S" is the keyboard shortcut; keep it as is.
document.menu.visual: Menu item that switches from the Markdown text back to the formatted editor.
document.menu.source: Menu item that shows the page's Markdown text instead of the formatted editor. Markdown is a format's name.
document.menu.to-page: Menu item on a folder: turns it back into a page with text.
document.menu.to-folder: Menu item: turns the page into a folder that holds other pages.
document.menu.move-within: Menu item: shows a picker to put the page under another page of the same Space.
document.menu.move-to: Menu item: opens a dialog to move the page to another Space.
document.menu.new-inside: Menu item on a folder: makes a new page inside it.
document.menu.new-subpage: Menu item: makes a new page under this one.
document.menu.follow-up: Menu item: opens a dialog that turns the page into a follow-up (a goal, an issue or a memory).
document.menu.download: Menu item: downloads the page as a Markdown (.md) file.
document.menu.source-thread: Menu item: opens the chat the page was made from.
document.menu.delete: Menu item: opens the dialog that confirms deleting the page.
document.notices.folder-save-first: Notice when unsaved changes kept the page from turning into a folder.
document.notices.folder-failed: Notice when turning the page into a folder (or back) failed.
document.notices.latest-confirm: Confirmation (the browser's own dialog) before replacing the person's draft with the latest saved version.
document.notices.latest-failed: Notice when the latest saved version couldn't load.
document.notices.retry: Button in a failed save's notice that tries the save again.
document.notices.download: Button in a save notice that downloads the person's draft as a file.
document.notices.load-latest: Button in a conflict notice that replaces the draft with the latest saved version.
document.notices.dismiss: Button that closes a notice above the page.
document.save-errors.conflict: Notice when someone else saved the page while the person was editing it.
document.save-errors.newer: Notice when the server has a newer version than the one just saved.
document.save-errors.timeout: Notice when a save took too long (often offline).
document.save-errors.failed: Notice when a save failed with no reason given.
document.save-errors.invalid: Notice when the draft is too long to save. {{title}} and {{content}} are the most characters a title and a page may have.
document.move.label: Label of the picker that puts the page under another page of the Space.
document.move.root: Choice in that picker: the top of the Space, under no page.
document.source.heading: Heading above the page's Markdown text. Markdown is a format's name.
document.source.label: Accessible name of the box holding the page's Markdown text.
document.source.reasons.extended: Why the page opens as Markdown text rather than in the formatted editor.
document.source.reasons.unsupported: Why the page opens as Markdown text rather than in the formatted editor.
document.source.reasons.round-trip: Why the page opens as Markdown text: the formatted editor could change some of it. "Round-tripped": opened and saved back unchanged.
document.source.reasons.unreadable: Why the page opens as Markdown text rather than in the formatted editor.
title.label: Accessible name of the page's title field.
folder.new-page: Button in a folder that makes a new page inside it.
folder.new-folder: Button in a folder that makes a new folder inside it.
folder.contents: Heading of the list of pages and folders inside a folder.
folder.kept: Note in a folder that was a page: its text is kept but hidden.
hierarchy.parents: Accessible name of the links to the pages above this one (on phones).
hierarchy.children: Heading of the links to the pages under this one.
outline.label: Accessible name of the side list of the Space's pages.
outline.heading: Heading of the side list of the Space's pages.
outline.new: Icon button in the side list that makes a new page.
outline.close: Icon button that closes the side list of pages.
missing.crumb: Breadcrumb in the header for a page that was deleted.
missing.loading: Shown while a page that isn't in the list yet is looked up.
missing.deleted: Heading where a deleted page was (a link led here).
missing.not-found: Heading where a page that doesn't exist in this Space would be.
missing.back: Button back to the Space's library of pages.
chat.label: Heading and accessible name of the chat about this page beside it.
chat.close: Icon button that closes the page's chat.
chat.ask-label: Accessible name of the box where the person asks a socio (AI agent) about the page.
chat.ask-placeholder: Placeholder of the box where the person asks a socio (AI agent) about the page.
chat.specialist: Accessible name of the picker of the socio (AI agent, here called a specialist) to ask.
chat.paused: Note beside the ask box: the workspace's AI is paused.
chat.uses-saved: Note beside the ask box: the socio reads the page as last saved.
chat.send: Accessible name of the send button of the ask box.
chat.save-first: Error when unsaved changes kept the page's chat from opening.
chat.failed: Error when the page's chat couldn't open.
chat.setup.add-specialist: In place of the ask box, for an admin: no socio (AI agent, a specialist) works in this Space yet.
chat.setup.ask-admin: In place of the ask box, for a member: no socio (AI agent, a specialist) works in this Space yet.
chat.setup.create-specialist: Button that opens the dialog to make a socio (AI agent).
chat.setup.connect: In place of the ask box: the workspace's AI model isn't set up yet.
chat.setup.set-up: Button that opens the settings to set up the AI model.
cover.add: Button above the page's title that opens the cover picker (a cover is a wide picture above the title).
cover.change: Button over the cover picture that opens the cover picker.
cover.remove: Button over the cover picture that removes it.
cover.gone: Shown where the cover picture was when its file was deleted.
cover.picker: Accessible name of the cover picker's popup.
cover.removed: Toast after the cover is removed.
cover.undo: Button in that toast that puts the cover back.
cover.undo-failed: Error when the cover couldn't be put back.
cover.remove-failed: Error when the cover couldn't be removed.
